duplicate_sensor_cycles.definition: Exact numeric equality of all within-cycle values in all 17 sensor matrices, after float64 parsing; target, cycle ID and other profile columns are excluded. SHA-256 narrows comparisons; candidate rows are also compared with array_equal.
duplicate_sensor_cycles.action: Report only; no cycles are automatically removed or relabeled

value_validation_scope: Numeric parsing, shape, NaN/infinity and profile code domains. Physical sensor range validity is not established by this audit.

download.checksum_basis: Locally observed SHA-256; not a publisher-supplied digest

ordering.cycle_id_basis: One-based original file row number; no shuffling or filtering
ordering.component_block_definition: Maximal consecutive run of identical first four profile columns
